description_expanded:
Prime location in NatureWalk, Seagrove Beach

4 bedroom, 3.5 bath

Resort-style pools, hot tub, heated lap pool, splash zone

Six-seater golf cart!

Dog-friendly!

Huge private backyard + 4 porches

Blackstone grill + gas fire pit

6 adult beach cruiser bikes!

Game room with ping pong & Smart TV

Surf Sanctuary by Oversee 30A | Perfect in Walton County Awards – Three-Time Diamond Winner – Best Rental Mgmt. 2026, 2025, 2024 Tucked inside NatureWalk, Surf Sanctuary is a gorgeous 30A home, where easy days and laid-back nights come standard. With elegant coastal décor, a spacious layout, and an unbeatable location near Seaside, WaterColor, and 30A’s best beaches, it’s the perfect escape for families, groups, and your pup. The open main living area feels bright and breezy, with a kitchen ready for yummy breakfasts, snack attacks, and everything in between. Upstairs, a second hangout zone waits for movie marathons or a quick escape from the chaos below. Outside, the oversized backyard is perfect for evening grill sessions and games under the stars. Catch the big game or sip your morning coffee from the screened porch – it’s your vacation, after all. Six bikes and a golf cart stand ready for adventures. Cruise the Lilly Lane trail to the beach or explore forest paths and hidden neighborhood corners.

Pools, pickleball courts, and plenty of roaming space for the kids seal the deal. At Oversee 30A, we keep it simple. Locally owned, always nearby, and ready to help seven days a week (with a 24/7 emergency line for those “oops” moments). Vacations are meant to be easy – and we make sure they are. Overview: - 2516 sq. ft. - WIFI - Dogs considered, an additional $210 non-refundable fee for each pet - 6-seater golf cart - 4 bedroom, 3.5 bath - 2 community pools - 6 bikes * Parking limited to two vehicles Overnight: FIRST FLOOR - Half Bath SECOND FLOOR - Primary Suite: King bed, with spa-style bathroom and soaking tub - Guest Suite: Queen bed, private bath - Guest Room: Queen bed, private balcony - Bunkroom: Twin-over-queen bunk with queen trundle (sleeps 5) Check-in is 4:00 PM CST. Checkout is 10:00 AM CST.
